compatibility.legacy_versionless_handoff: MIGRATABLE when stable task_id/owner and authoritative evidence are resolvable; otherwise UNKNOWN

artifact_io.reason: Video Growth persists task/checkpoint metadata, production artifacts and evidence refs, and may use owner-designated external artifact stores; material mutations require stable identity, CAS and post-write reread.

operational_hygiene.reason: The owner handles protocol/capability/authority drift, stale-writer failures, scoped maintenance reconciliation, cleanup and reliability blocking before business progress.

evolution.reason: This maintenance turn performs durable critique, alternative comparison, failure-mode testing, regression-backed hardening and persistence of accepted system changes.

hook_bindings.authoritative_business_evidence_classes: GitHub main Skill/config/runtime/project records plus exact business-evidence refs named by the active task
hook_bindings.canonical_artifact_or_file_stores: GitHub main for control-plane and business execution authority; owner-designated external stores only when explicitly referenced with stable identity
hook_bindings.cache_or_reference_only_stores: ChatGPT Library, Notion, Google Drive and session/tool caches are non-authoritative by default unless the active owner/task explicitly designates business evidence
hook_bindings.stable_identity_strategy: repository path plus Git blob/commit SHA for GitHub; provider stable ID/canonical ref for external artifacts
hook_bindings.read_freshness_requirements: Re-read current GitHub main authority before material continuity/owner mutation; chat memory, prior-chat reads and caches do not satisfy freshness
hook_bindings.mutation_conflict_strategy: GitHub contents blob-SHA compare-and-swap; fail closed on version mismatch or stale writer
hook_bindings.post_write_verification_method: Re-read each materially mutated owner/continuity file from GitHub main and verify intended fields, active lease and resume_epoch
hook_bindings.upstream_to_downstream_invalidation_rule: Protocol/owner metadata reconciliation must not mutate or replay domain business state; domain owner runtime controls business invalidation
hook_bindings.delete_and_retention_rules: Continuity maintenance must not delete business evidence; continuity/owner metadata may be removed only when superseded and dependency-safe
hook_bindings.superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule: Keep one active continuity/owner authority surface; demote/remove superseded active metadata when replacement is verified, using Git history as implementation archive
hook_bindings.external_artifact_vault_if_any: Google Drive may serve as an optional owner-designated deliverable/evidence vault with stable provider refs; never as implicit control-plane authority
hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: GitHub commit/CI evidence plus continuity task checkpoint/adaptation metadata and referenced audits
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: Protocol/capability/authority drift or user-requested self-audit -> current valid owner writer performs scoped critique, regression-backed maintenance and post-write verification
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: Valid owner/maintenance writer may clean superseded continuity mechanisms only after dependency/retention checks; never garbage-collect active business evidence
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: Fail closed on stale writer, unknown authority or failed verification; system maintenance must not advance business stage or next_action
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: audits/SYSTEM_SELF_AUDIT_2026-10-10.md plus self-learning/production-intelligence evidence, project work-order/reviewer receipts and post-publication performance evidence when available
hook_bindings.eval_or_regression_promotion_path: Challenge initial solution, compare alternatives, search failure modes, patch the minimum authority surface, add adversarial regression tests, require CI pass, then reread authority before claiming promotion
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: Accepted evolution replaces weaker mechanisms: hard-coded process-stage enforcement was replaced by execution-plan-derived enforcement, and the combined art_creative pregen approval was removed in favor of three separate specialist evidence slots

overrides.evaluator_selection: Video methodology promotion uses failure-mode tests, current CI, owner capability truth and benchmark/artifact evidence; true reviewer isolation remains subject to execution-capability attestation

methodology_assurance.boundary: This records current-writer control-plane maintenance and regression-backed evolution. It does not claim Production Methodologist/Red Team/Evolution Engineer were separately attested executions in this chat, and it does not make any reviewer provider trusted.

writer_guard.new_chat_takeover: increment resume_epoch, replace active_lease, re-read manifest and verify before substantive work

checkpoint_conformance.rule: Checkpoint carries current execution truth plus refs; duplicated business rules/history belong in stronger project/Skill authorities.
checkpoint_conformance.cross_domain_pollution_guard: Unverified preserved requirements without Video Growth authority must not become durable video rules.
checkpoint_conformance.defer_reason: Self-audit hardening was kept separate from checkpoint compaction so business-state representation is not rewritten while runtime governance is being validated.

notes: Universal Continuity owns routing, protocol adaptation and recovery pointers only; it must not duplicate video workflow/business state machines.
